instruction: A cinematic still with natural colors and a shallow depth of field captures a medium shot of four children standing in an outdoor park with green trees in the background. On the far left, the boy wearing glasses and a light yellow t-shirt (R3) stands with his right arm draped over the shoulder of the girl next to him, looking at the camera with a gentle smile. Next to him, the girl with curly hair tied up, wearing a white cardigan over a reddish-brown jumpsuit (R1), smiles warmly with her arms around the shoulders of the boys on either side. The boy in the blue denim button-up shirt (R4) stands second from the right, smiling brightly with his arm around the girl with dark hair and bangs, wearing a dark blue cardigan over a striped dress (R2), who grins happily on the far right. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the trees from behind, creating a soft backlighting effect.
elements: R3 drapes his right arm over R1's shoulder
R1 places her arms around the shoulders of R3 and R4
R4 puts his arm around R2
R2 is the child receiving R4's arm around her
the children stand together in an outdoor park with green trees

questions.element: R3 drapes his right arm over R1's shoulder

questions.element: R4 puts his arm around R2

questions.element: R1 is connected by shoulder contact to R3 and R4

questions.element: R2 is the child receiving R4's arm around her
